o.text: From Proto-Turkic *ül-, *öl-č- (“measure; measure, measuring”), whence also Azerbaijani ölçmək (“to measure”). Cognate with Turkish ülgü, Chuvash ӗлкӗ (ĕlk̬ĕ, “pattern”).
Calque of Russian верхо́вный главнокома́ндующий (verxóvnyj glavnokomándujuščij).
Borrowed from Persian ترکمان (torkamân). Doublet of türkmən.
Partial calque of Russian суперклей (superklej), ultimately a genericized trademark held by Super Glue Corporation. By surface analysis, super- + yapışqan.
